subject.title: fix(release): unblock Meta npm bootstrap publication

question: Do release owners approve the exact evidence-bound Meta registry-token bootstrap inside the protected plugin npm workflow?
rationale: The implementation is technically bounded, but it intentionally changes the production release credential boundary; automated review cannot authorize secret use or publication policy.

options.title: Approve bounded bootstrap
options.body: Merge after exact-head checks complete and a release owner confirms that only fixed trusted workflow code sees the token.

options.title: Bootstrap separately
options.body: Keep the canonical workflow OIDC-only and perform the initial Meta publication through a separately audited administrative operation.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded bootstrap
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head checks complete and a release owner confirms that only fixed trusted workflow code sees the token.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the evidence contract and have the strongest recent ownership and assignment trail for this exact release behavior.
